div.div:
Open questions
1. How to do the train / val / test split even though we are running zero-shot models?
2. How can we do initial data exploration? “Just go partly manual?” Can we do some inline statistics to help us optimize?
3. How to do live augmentation / segmentation? SAM + dynamic mask?
